{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of rows with biomarker_baseline == -999: {data[data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999].shape[0]}")

# Check for duplicate patient_ids
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {data['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()}")

# Check for multiple sample_seq per patient
sample_seq_counts = data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].count()
duplicates_with_multiple_rows = sample_seq_counts[sample_seq_counts > 1].shape[0]
print(f"Number of patients with multiple sample_seq entries: {duplicates_with_multiple_rows}")

# Check assay_batch distribution
print(f"Assay batch distribution: {data['assay_batch'].value_counts().to_dict()}")"}
